fields.name: is_member
fields.doc:
Current San Francisco Folk Music Club membership is
required to attend Camp Harmony.
Please [verify that you are a current member by clicking here](https://www.sffmc.org/log-in/?redirect_to=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sffmc.org%2Fmembership-account%2F)
to log into the site to check your expiration or auto-renew date. If you don't
know your password or haven't logged in before, click the "Lost Password" link
to request a new password.  If you believe you are a member but are unable to
log in even after requesting a new password, contact SFFMC membership secretary
Ellen Eagan at [membership@sffmc.org](mailto:membership@sffmc.org) for
assistance. If you are new to the Folk Club, [click here to join](https://www.sffmc.org/join-us/).
fields.title: SFFMC Membership

and towel) for an additional $25. Would you like to rent linens?

filters.name: money
filters.doc: Format an amount as money. Blank stays blank.

filters.name: date
filters.doc: Format a date (or a datetime or "YYYY-MM-DD" text) with strftime codes: %a Tue, %A Tuesday, %b Dec, %B December, %-d 30, %Y 2026.

filters.name: datetime
filters.doc: Format a date and time, in the event time zone unless `tz` is given.

filters.name: to_date
filters.doc: Turn "YYYY-MM-DD" text (e.g. a form answer) into a date you can compare.

filters.name: csv
filters.doc: Quote a value for a CSV cell when it needs it (commas, quotes, line breaks).

filters.name: csv_row
filters.doc: A CSV line from a list of values.

filters.name: md_cell
filters.doc: Escape text for a Markdown table cell.

filters.name: regex_replace
filters.doc: Replace every match of a regular expression.

filters.name: merge
filters.doc: A new dict with the keys of both — for building your own rows.

filters.name: dump
filters.doc: Show a value as JSON, to see what it contains while writing a template.

filters.name: money_fmt
filters.doc: Legacy: round to two decimal places. Prefer `money`.

filters.name: pprint
filters.doc: Readable form of a value, for debugging.

filters.name: default
filters.doc: A fallback when a value is missing (or, with `true`, empty).

filters.name: sort
filters.doc: Sort a list; `attribute` may be a dotted path, or several separated by commas.

filters.name: selectattr
filters.doc: Keep items whose attribute passes a test.

filters.name: rejectattr
filters.doc: Drop items whose attribute passes a test.

filters.name: map
filters.doc: Pick one attribute from every item, or apply a filter to each.

filters.name: groupby
filters.doc: Group items by an attribute; gives (grouper, list) pairs.
filters.example: {% for lodging, group in campers | groupby('lodging.full_name') %}

filters.name: sum
filters.doc: Add up numbers, or one attribute of every item.

filters.name: list
filters.doc: Turn a sequence into a list (e.g. after selectattr).

filters.name: batch
filters.doc: Split a list into groups of `size`.

filters.name: dictsort
filters.doc: Sort a dict into (key, value) pairs.
filters.example: {% for key, value in camper.attributes | dictsort %}

filters.name: select
filters.doc: Keep items that pass a test.

filters.name: reject
filters.doc: Drop items that pass a test.

filters.name: items
filters.example: {% for key, value in camper.attributes | items %}

filters.name: filesizeformat
filters.doc: A byte count as readable text.

filters.name: urlize
filters.doc: Turn URLs in text into links.

filters.name: forceescape
filters.doc: Escape HTML even if already safe.

filters.name: safe
filters.doc: Mark text as safe HTML (HTML reports only).

filters.name: wordwrap
filters.doc: Wrap long text at a width.

tests.name: sequence
tests.doc: The value is a list (or text).

tests.name: iterable
tests.doc: The value can be looped over.

tests.name: boolean
tests.doc: The value is true or false.

tests.name: integer
tests.doc: The value is a whole number.

tests.name: float
tests.doc: The value is a decimal number.

tests.name: in
tests.doc: The value is in a list.

tests.name: filter
tests.doc: A filter with this name exists.

tests.name: test
tests.doc: A test with this name exists.

tags.name: for
tags.doc: Repeat for each item. `loop` describes the current pass; add `{% else %}` for when the list is empty.

tags.name: if
tags.doc: Output something only when a condition holds; `elif` / `else` add branches.

tags.name: do
tags.doc: Run an expression without output — e.g. add to your own list.

tags.name: macro
tags.doc: A reusable piece of template with parameters.

tags.name: with
tags.doc: Names that only exist inside the block.

tags.name: filter
tags.doc: Apply a filter to a whole block.

tags.name: continue
tags.doc: Skip to the next pass of the loop.

tags.name: comment
tags.doc: A comment that never appears in the output.

globals.name: range
globals.doc: Numbers from start up to stop.

globals.name: namespace
globals.doc: A container whose attributes can change inside loops — for running totals.
globals.example: {% set ns = namespace(total=0) %}{% for r in registrations %}{% set ns.total = ns.total + r.balance %}{% endfor %}

globals.name: dict
globals.doc: A new dict you can change.

globals.name: joiner
globals.doc: Outputs a separator every time but the first.
